headline: Waymo begins welcoming riders in Denver, Tampa, and San Diego
summary: The company's service notice distinguishes gradual rider access from general availability.

headline: Limited public rides begin in four additional cities
summary: Waymo announced rider access in Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Orlando.

headline: Aurora outlines fleet and corridor plans in shareholder letter
summary: Its second-quarter filing discusses driverless fleet allocation and customer routes; the targets are company projections.

headline: Aurora launches second-generation driverless trucks
summary: Aurora describes the updated commercial hardware fleet and customer rollout.

headline: May Mobility and Lyft launch an Atlanta fleet
summary: The partners describe their first autonomous fleet on the Lyft platform.

headline: PepsiCo and Gatik announce freight agreement
summary: The companies describe a multiyear autonomous freight arrangement in PepsiCo's North American supply chain.

headline: Gatik reports scaled driverless commercial deliveries
summary: Company announcement on expanded freight operations and its vehicle program.

headline: NHTSA grants temporary commercial vehicle exemption
summary: The federal exemption addresses Zoox's purpose-built robotaxi design; state and local service approvals are separate.

headline: Zoox launches public Las Vegas service
summary: Zoox describes availability on and near the Strip through its own app.

headline: Uber and Avride launch Dallas robotaxi rides
summary: The initial service covered a limited nine-square-mile area with an onboard safety operator.

headline: Beep announces funding led by Mobileye
summary: The company says the round supports commercial autonomous mobility networks.

headline: ATL Spoke pilot opens in Atlanta
summary: Beep and Atlanta Beltline announced public service for an autonomous transit pilot.

headline: Atlas expands Kodiak-powered driverless fleet
summary: The partners set a timetable to grow the Atlas fleet in the Permian Basin.

headline: Kodiak and Bosch reach hardware agreement
summary: The companies announced work on autonomous trucking hardware and sensors.

headline: Uber and Motional launch Las Vegas robotaxi service
summary: Uber riders became eligible to match with Motional IONIQ 5 vehicles.

headline: Motional begins driverless Las Vegas testing
summary: Testing preceded the public ridehail launch and should be distinguished from paid service.

headline: Reuters reports unsupervised Austin rollout
summary: The report covers Tesla's announcement of unsupervised rides in Austin; it does not establish the same operating mode in every market.

headline: Waabi announces funding and Uber robotaxi partnership
summary: The company describes future robotaxi deployment and continuing trucking development; the announced robotaxis are not counted as live rides.
